name: Cannalope Jeeter Infused Pre-Roll | 1g
description: Escape to a tropical paradise with Cannalope! This indica is a deliciously refreshing experience with its juicy melon and tropical fruit flavors on the inhale and perfectly complementing exhale of pine and spices that come from its kush lineage. With its deeply relaxing effects and light physical tingles, Cannalope is the perfect strain for unwinding and enjoying a laid-back island vibe any time of year.
